map.输入偏振光干涉条纹级数与材料条纹值，计算透明件（玻璃/塑料/光学元件）的双折射应: Enter the polarized light interference fringe order and the material fringe value to compute the birefringence stress difference of a transparent part (glass/plastic/optical element), automatically determine the stress grade and give a quality evaluation.
map.📖 查看「光弹性应力分析 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Photoelastic Stress Analysis User Guide"
map.玻璃内应力（光程差法）：主应力差 σ = N × f ÷ d，N 为光弹条纹数、: Glass internal stress (optical path difference method): principal stress difference σ = N × f ÷ d, where N is the photoelastic fringe number, f the stress-optic constant (nm/cm·MPa) and d the plate thickness (cm); a stress difference below 5 MPa is very small, 5-15 moderate, above 15 large (tempered glass needs over 90 MPa).
map.应力-光学定律：σ₁ - σ₂ = N × f / d（MPa）: Stress-optic law: σ₁ - σ₂ = N × f / d (MPa)
map.条纹级数N通过偏振光干涉仪（正交偏振场）读取: The fringe order N is read via a polarized light interferometer (crossed polariscope)
map.钢化玻璃残余应力：表面压应力应>90MPa，中心张应力<45MPa: Tempered glass residual stress: surface compressive stress should be >90 MPa, center tensile stress <45 MPa
map.光学元件双折射：精密级<10nm/cm，普通级<50nm/cm: Optical element birefringence: precision grade <10 nm/cm, ordinary grade <50 nm/cm
map.装配后偏光镜下看应力斑判装配合格。: After assembly, view stress spots under a polariscope to judge assembly qualification.
map.应力过大易崩边/畸变。: Excessive stress easily chips the edge/causes distortion.
map.偏光镜观察无彩色条纹/局部亮斑=合格；边缘明显彩纹=装夹过紧，需松框重装以免长期: No color fringes/local bright spots under a polariscope = qualified; obvious color fringes at the edge = over-tight clamping, requiring looser reassembly to avoid edge chipping from long-term stress.
map.应力等级 0–3，≤1 合格、2 需复检、3 不合格；塑料架比金属架更易过夹，须: Stress grades 0-3: ≤1 qualified, 2 needs re-inspection, 3 unqualified; plastic frames are more prone to over-clamping than metal frames, so torque must be controlled.
map.装配过紧产生双折射与畸变，长期可致镜片开裂，尤其 PC/高折片敏感。: Over-tight assembly produces birefringence and distortion and can crack the lens over time, especially on stress-sensitive PC/high-index lenses.
map.需偏光片+标准光源，肉眼看不出，门店用应力仪客观判级。: It requires a polarizer + standard light source and is invisible to the naked eye; stores use a stress meter for objective grading.
map.偏振光应力分析工具，利用应力-光学定律（σ=N×f/d）计算透明件主应力差，支持: A polarized light stress analysis tool that uses the stress-optic law (σ=N×f/d) to compute the principal stress difference of transparent parts, supporting materials such as borosilicate glass/soda-lime glass/PMMA/PC and automatically determining the stress grade.
map.应力-光学定律一键计算主应力差: One-click principal stress difference via the stress-optic law
map.4种常见材料条纹值预设: Four common material fringe value presets
map.光程差换算与质量评价: Optical path difference conversion and quality evaluation
